## Why it stopped here

`/build` only runs the full chain — write code, open a PR, stage a deploy — when git, `gh` (logged in), and a browser tool are all present. One is missing here (`gh`), so `/build` exits clean at this check. It does not fall back to a smaller version of the job; it stops and tells you what's missing. This is `/build`'s own rule, not something I chose.

It also never touched Phase 0's hard floor check (the one that refuses to write auth, schema, or security code) or noticed you're on the `main` branch — both of those checks come later, and `/build` didn't get that far.

## Next step

Install and log in to GitHub's CLI tool, then run `/build signup-page` again:

```
brew install gh      # or your package manager
gh auth login
```

Once that's done, re-running `/build signup-page` will also need a feature branch — `/build` refuses to run from `main`. Want me to create one (e.g. `feature/signup-page`) now so it's ready for the next run?
